new_value: {"notes":"The original EDHOC description was stale and was corrected to the current global Yggdrasil OSCORE Rule 6 contract. Generalized the canonical global CoAP inverse for Rules 1/6 while preserving distinct profile enforcement. Rule 6 now reads exactly the 286-bit/36-byte residue, reconstructs exact 0x02/8 addresses from 120-bit suffixes, restores 5680..5695 ports and CoAP fields, rejects both nonzero padding bits, validates TKL/token and exactly one RFC 8613-valid OSCORE option, enforces compressed profile and caller-output bounds, and rebuilds IPv6/UDP lengths/checksum. All reachable errors occur before the first output write. Global Rule 1 also rejects a valid OSCORE tail, preventing security-profile relabeling. Added isolated lichen/tests/schc_rule6_decompress coverage for canonical shared Python-oracle bytes, independent fields plus byte-exact recompression, every truncated residue length 1..36, both padding bits, Rule1 relabeling, reserved TKL, missing/absent/invalid/duplicate OSCORE, empty payload marker, undersized output, and exact 22,554 acceptance / 22,555 rejection. Validation: strict host C build + UBSan ctest passed 1/1; Python Rule6 inverse+compression 33 passed; isolated Rust Rule6 compression+decompression 15 passed; focused cppcheck and git diff --check clean."}
